description: Positive control for the K-class insensitivity claim: the deposited masked-line ablation machinery (fixed production LightGBM model, 456 held-out test rows, class-matched null, bin-matched non-overlapping random windows) applied to four additional line sets chosen to be maximally K-relevant: the union of all five catalogued windows (Joint_all) and the 20, 50 and 100 bins with the largest validation-set mean |SHAP| for the K class. The five deposited sets are run first in the same call. Two fills: gp_interp (primary, linear interpolation) and constant (train off-gap median).

production__gp_interp.note: linear np.interp across each masked run

production__constant.note: median of the TRAIN matrix outside the gap

shap.sample: all 454 validation rows (sample_idx = positions 0..453 within val_idx; y_sample equals y[val_idx])
shap.top_n_rule: exclude gap bins; rank bins by mean_abs_per_class[2] (K) in stable descending order; take the N largest; sort the selected bin indices and group maximal runs of consecutive indices; each run becomes the window (wave_centers[start], wave_centers[end]) so that _window_mask (inclusive on bin centres) recovers exactly the selected bins (asserted)

inputs.joint_all_rule: concatenation of the windows of the five deposited sets in table order
inputs.joint_all_bin_count_note: the brief anticipated 85 bins; _window_mask gives the verified count above (29 + 8 + 4 + 2 + 13, the five sets do not overlap)

reproduction_check.description: Row-by-row comparison with artifacts/revision/ablation_recalibrated.json. 'passed' and 'max_abs_diff' refer to the five deposited sets re-run alone under the exact deposited configuration (production__gp_interp). 'passed_literal_nine_set_assertion' is the brief's assertion applied to the first five sets of the nine-set call; its p-values are not expected to reproduce because masked_line_ablation forbids the random-window sampler from every bin of every line set it is given, so the SHAP sets shrink the sampling region and shift the random-number stream.
